The plate is square, about 21 cm across in the image (roughly 130–620 px wide, so about 24 px per cm). The tuna salad mound is about 220 px wide, around 9 cm, and about 240 px tall, around 10 cm. That is an area of roughly 70 cm² at a height of about 2.5 cm. This gives about 120–150 cm³ of volume. Allowing for the mixture being loose, I estimate about 120 g.

The salad looks like tuna mixed with celery, red onion, a little carrot and a mayonnaise-type dressing. I split it into tuna at about 85 g, mayo binder at about 20 g, and celery, onion and carrot at about 15 g.

The shredded carrot on the side plate is only partly visible. I estimate about 50 g of it.
